UNIQUE TEXTURE- Its smooth tear drop profile is interrupted by sets of hand-carved waving lines, exposing the true texture of the mango tree, creating a charming and exotic statement in any living space.
REAL HARDWOOD- Not only stylish, with its warm brown tones and deep hand-carved grooves, it's made from sturdy mango wood, making it durable and no negative impact on the environment.
HAND-CRAFTED- Each Villacera Handmade Mango Vase is uniquely hand carved out of sustainable mango hardwood, leaving minimal differences in the fresh, natural carvings of each piece.

PRODUCT DETAILS- Dimensions: (L) 5" x (H) 15" x (W) 5". Material: Mango wood. To clean, hand wash with damp cloth & towel dry. Do not let your mango wood item sit in water or remain wet for extended periods of time.
